name: integration-discovery

messages.content: Find explicit integration evidence: API documentation, EHR/EMR marketplace listings, partner and implementation guides, and pages describing connectivity, sync, or interoperability. Prefer pages that name a specific integration partner product or company over pages that only describe integrations generically ("most EHRs," "leading practice management systems") without naming one; a generic category is not extractable evidence even if the page is otherwise on-topic. Still retain broader integration directories and lists when they name real products, even if the technical connection isn't fully spelled out — they may contain useful evidence once scraped. Beyond the vendor's own site, integration evidence often lives on marketplace listings (Microsoft Marketplace, health-IT partner marketplaces), third-party customer-usage databases (AppsRunTheWorld), industry-association resource guides, and partner announcement pages on the partner's own site rather than the vendor's.

public_policy: Latest source version adapted for public research; private naming tables, frequency tiers, source-policy details and hosted provenance omitted.
